name: dismay
quote: Dang, I just missed the train.
description: An unpleasant, intense, and short experience of something unexpectedly missing expectations in a bad way. If it's a minor drop in your life situation, the feeling will dissipate quickly. If a major drop, it may fade into sadness.
perceptions: It doesn't significantly affect anything long lasting.

comparisons.description: Dismay is a short negative feeling about something minor. Sadness is a longer-lasting sensation about a negative outcome. Gloom is the robust ability to stay negative even without a specific event or memory.

commentaries.quote: Dismay is the basic deep-down negative experience. There are many complex experiences that come with a deep sense of loss or regret we call dismay. For example, at a social level, missing the train may create regret about telling others you're going to miss dinner.
Disappointment is just the initial shock of the universe reminding you that life doesn’t always go according to plan.
